description: It's Solaris-X, A team passionate about weaving creativity into every project through art and design!!
summary: An engaging visual and audio narrative series designed for high school audiences that uncovers NASA’s archived missions and shelved inventions. Through compelling voiceovers and digital visuals, ShelfSpace explores why brilliant engineering marvels were abandoned—and how the "failed" technologies of yesterday serve as the blueprint for tomorrow’s space discoveries.
details: Ever wanted to learn about NASA's past missions? All you find is some websites with very technical data, no creativity, no engagement, no spark of imagination. Which is why we built ShelfSpace, an engaging website built with blender, Ibis paint, Claude and vercel, combining 3D and 2D, Where Hiro takes the student through an adventure with opportunity and spirit, the twin rovers. Showing the student the impacts of that mission, and what it achieved!
dataRefs: Mars exploration rovers: spirit and opportunity
